_about: Map layers computed by tools/build_layers.py (polar, sp and np) and build_layers_global.py (gl) from LRO LOLA elevation (NASA PDS) and NASA NAIF SPICE DE440 positions (data/ephem.bin); temperatures re-gridded from LRO Diviner by build_temperature.py. Polar grids: north-up polar stereographic, pole in the middle, x toward longitude 90E; y toward longitude 0 on the south grid and away from it on the north grid. sun / earth 0..200 = 0..100 % of the time; shadow 1 = no part of the Sun seen at any checked moment; slope in tenths of a degree; 255 = no data.

temperature.source: LRO Diviner Polar Resource Product V2.0 (Paige et al., LRO-L-DLRE-5-PRP-V2.0, NASA PDS, 2018)

ice.source: LRO Diviner Polar Resource Product V2.0 (Paige et al., LRO-L-DLRE-5-PRP-V2.0, NASA PDS, 2018), column ice_depth
ice.unit: value * 0.0125 = meters; 254 = deeper than 2.87 m (not reported by NASA); 255 = no data
ice.note: NASA's code -1 (ground whose yearly maximum is 101 K or less; not described in the product label) is stored as 0, at the surface
